title: Red-Team Test Report
description: A report documenting adversarial red-team testing of a publicly-facing AI system, including simulated coordinated-manipulation attempts, and confirmation that the kill-switch/rollback mechanism was tested and worked within its target response time.
evidence_description: A report documenting the scenarios tested during adversarial red-teaming (including coordinated-manipulation simulations), findings, remediations applied, and a record of the kill-switch/rollback drill including measured response time.
collection_method: Structured red-team exercise conducted before launch and on a recurring schedule thereafter, with drill results logged automatically where possible.
retention_period: Minimum 3 years, and retained for the lifetime of the system version tested.
artifact_format: PDF report; drill timing data retained as structured export.
